i.why_not: spread 1.18 px exceeds the estimator's own accuracy of 1.10 px

method: per galaxy: mean-subtract each band, zero-pad to 2x, accumulate cross-power spectra over the bin, invert once. Zero-padding makes this a linear (not circular) correlation, so there is no wrap-around.
how_to_read: width_px for a band with itself is that band's PSF proxy. If the y-y width exceeds the z-z width, y is intrinsically blurrier and no pixelwise rescaling of z can reproduce it -- a hard limit on B0/B1 that argues for a spatial model. peak_lag should be (0,0); anything else means the bands are misregistered.
